LTM has become the first global systems integrator to publish an AI‑powered quantum error mitigation solution in IBM’s official catalog, marking a milestone for enterprise-level integration of quantum technologies. The inclusion demonstrates IBM’s commitment to expanding access to advanced quantum tooling and underscores LTM’s leadership in delivering practical, AI–enhanced quantum solutions. This achievement enables organizations to leverage robust error mitigation through a trusted partner, accelerating the adoption of quantum computing at scale.
